text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 429/503 from inference-prod (east-us-1). 5xx steady but 429s jumping ~4x in last 10m. paging: @devon (oncall), @ben-sre, @maria. runbook -> https://console.redwood.com/runbooks/traffic-mitigation

devon: ACK. I'm looking at the 429 heatmap now. Sharing dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/infra/429-503-trends?env=prod&region=eastus1&range=15m

maria: seeing tenant-level burst on tenant-id: t-83a2 (high QPS) causing queue backs. Affected routes: /v1/generate (chat), /v1/embeddings (async).

ben-sre: quick question — do we have active canary rollout for the new batching change? could be a perf regression. @telemetry-bot any recent deploys?

telemetry-bot: DEPLOY: batcher-service v2.3.1 deployed to eastus1 at 2367543005 by ci-cd-bot. No rollback detected.

lisa-ops: tagging customers: some PLG tenants hit rate limits; CS is starting outreach. @anne-cs standing by for customer impact notes.

anne-cs: reaching out to top 5 affected accounts now. ETA 8m for initial customer DM. ETA 20m for status page update if we confirm degraded.

devon: triage steps I'm running (doing now):
1) throttle top noisy tenant (t-83a2) to soft cap 20 req/s
2) enable temporary global short-circuit caching for prefix-heavy requests
3) bump per-route burst token bucket down for /v1/embeddings
4) if still bad, disable batcher v2.3.1 and roll back to v2.3.0

devon: applying soft tenant cap now. command:
```bash
# apply tenant quota (control-plane)
redwoodctl tenants update t-83a2 --qps 20 --burstable=false --reason "live mitigation 429 surge"
```

maria: confirmed control-plane accepted the change. token-usage graph shows t-83a2 dropping from ~450rps -> ~18rps in ~30s.

ben-sre: I pushed a transient feature-flag to bypass new batching on eastus1 for inference runtime: `ff-optimizer.disable_batching=true` (scoped). Patch applied via ops-run 2367543300.

devon: checking 429 rate after mitigations. Initial 429 rate: 160/min. After tenant cap + ff change: 429 rate -> 42/min in 3m. 503s remain ~12/min (unchanged).

telemetry-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT:
- 429 total (15m window): 1,240 -> 360 after mitigations
- 503 total (15m window): 180 (stable)
- Request Latency p95 (inference-prod): 720ms -> 940ms (some tail increase)

lisa-ops: cohort note: smaller customers saw degraded embedding latency but not total failures. We're marking high-risk customers and escalating to CSMs.

ben-sre: digging into kernel queues on serving nodes — I see increased NVMe stall retries on node pool gpux-3. Could be IO interference from KV-cache flush.

maria: quick check on cache: KV cache eviction rate spiked at 2367543080 after a flush. suspect new batcher variant triggers aggressive cache churn.

devon: decision log: keep tenant cap and feature-flag for 30m window, monitor. If 429s continue to drop, we'll schedule a controlled rollback of batcher v2.3.1 in canary then prod.

raj-pm: note for incident review — capture timeline + affected customers and cost impact of mitigation (throttling vs rollback).

anne-cs: status page draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates (429) for inference requests in east-us-1. Mitigation steps in flight; customer support contacting affected accounts." Will post after confirmation.

devon: running continuous check script (polls dashboards every 60s). output snippet:
```text
T+60s: 429/min = 210
T+120s: 429/min = 78
T+180s: 429/min = 46
T+240s: 429/min = 39
```

ben-sre: also kicked off a job to collect heap profiles from batcher pods in canary for postmortem. job id: j-5489.

telemetry-bot: alert-suppression: suppressing non-critical 429 paging in eastus1 for next 10m to reduce noise (policy applied).

devon: customer impact sample: tenant t-83a2 saw 40% increase in error budget consumption for the hour. Others are <5%. CS outreach underway.

maria: ops note — I recommend a short-term pod-level IO throttling to gpux-3 pool while we validate batcher rollback. Can anyone authorize? @ben-sre?

ben-sre: authorize. running IO throttle via clusterctl: `clusterctl node update gpux-3 --io-share=40%` (applied 2367543505).

devon: current status (2367543630):
- 429s reduced ~70% from peak, trending down
- 503s unchanged (investigation queued)
- tenant t-83a2 throttled and stable at cap
- batching feature-flag disabled in eastus1
- IO throttle applied to gpux-3 nodes

next steps:
- continue monitoring 30m window, if stable start controlled canary rollback for batcher v2.3.1 OR schedule full rollback depending on canary results
- ben to gather kernel/IO traces, maria to collect cache eviction trace, devon to coordinate postmortem and timeline
- anne to post initial status page update and CS batch messages

devon: tagging for handoff to next oncall in 30m @ben-sre will take secondary oversight. I'll update runbook and add mitigation entries. :thumbsup:

anne-cs: posting status on status.redwood.com now. will DM affected accounts with mitigation status and ETA for follow-up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation actions applied. Continue to report changes in this thread. Pager silence in 10m for non-critical 429s.

ben-sre: ack, taking secondary. will follow up with traces and postmortem items."
